title.narrative: TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE TO STRENGTHENING URBAN PLANNING LAW AND METROPOLITAN MANAGEMENT IN THE STATE OF YUCATAN, MEXICO

description.narrative:
The current project is the result of several conversations with the state of Yucatán to support them in the localization and mainstreaming of the sustainable development principles of global agendas in their state urban normative and legal frameworks.
The main objective of the collaboration is to support the state of Yucatan in the process that is undertaking to develop a normative proposal on sustainable urban development, aligned with the New Urban Agenda and the 2030 Agenda, in order to generate positive impacts on the territory and cities and to improve the quality of life of the population.
The project has a duration of one year and responds to an specific request of the state to provide technical assistance on state urban legislation related to sustainable urban development, mobility and housing.
The technical scope of the collaboration includes: • Technical support and advice for the creation of the Metropolitan Planning and Management Institute through the review and comments on the proposed strategic model of operation and management of the institute. • Documentary review, alignment with global agendas and working groups with specialists to identify areas for reform of the following state legal framework: o State Law on Human Settlements o Real Estate Development Law o Organic Law of the Urban Development Attorney's Office.
The project considers also a crosscutting effort of participatory and technical processes to link local stakeholders during the elaboration of the proposals. To guarantee the integration of a gender approach in the process the participation of women (participation of women in strategic positions in state and local government, academia and civil society) is a priority and will be considered during the development of the methodologies for the participatory and technical processes.
It is relevant to mention that the project will consider different lessons learned from the Agency, and collaboration with some relevant global divisions. The project will build on and apply global tools and methodologies already developed by UN-Habitat. These methodologies and lessons learned are described in detail in section 2.3, however, due to their relevance they are detailed below: • Governance assessment framework for metropolitan, territorial and regional management. UN-Habitat, 2020. • Metropolitan Institutions: Bases for the structuring and management of the metropolitan authority. UN-Habitat, 2020. • Planning Law Assessment Framework. UN-Habitat, 2016. • Slum Upgrading Legal Assessment Framework, UN-Habitat, 2022. • Urban Law Module of the Law and Climate Change Toolkit, 2022. • Economic foundations for sustainable urbanization. Planned city extensions, legal framework, and municipal finance. UN-Habitat, 2017. • Participatory Incremental Urban Planning Toolbox (Our City Plans): A Toolbox to support local governments in developing countries to implement the New Urban Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals. UN-Habitat 2020. • Human Rights, Rule of Law and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat, 2020.
This list might be adjusted or broadened based on recommendations received in the review of this document.
